inheritance: Inherit v1 cohort, quality, benchmark, clock, amendment and outcome rules. This amendment replaces the comparator, estimand and claim gate. The proposed 2027 window is retained as planning only.
candidate: Apply the v1 tail and minimum-gap thresholds. On a flag use minus sign(opening_return) to isolate the selection question. Require a nonzero opening return. A common quality failure gives both rules zero allocation.

comparator.rule: At the same clock allocate minus sign(opening_return) if its absolute value strictly exceeds the fixed magnitude threshold, otherwise zero.
comparator.fit: Match the number flagged by the candidate in the development diagnostic. Consider zero, each distinct nonzero opening magnitude, and adjacent midpoints. Minimize absolute flag-count difference, then prefer fewer flags, then the largest threshold. Keep ties together. Freeze the threshold before any fresh cohort. Do not adjust it to prospective coverage.

estimand: Mean of (candidate allocation minus magnitude allocation) times opening-to-close return over the common decision-eligible cohort with an observed clean outcome. Each unflagged allocation is zero. Identical allocations contribute zero. Retain missing outcomes in attrition and report an all-event sensitivity. Never fill missing outcome on a discordant row with zero.
coverage: Report both flag rates, signed allocation overlap and discordance, issuer and session counts, and outcome attrition. Development coverage matching is a design constraint. Report any prospective coverage imbalance as part of the interpretation without rematching.
feasibility_gate: Before a confirmatory collection proposal, require a nonzero development discordance count and a supported clustered precision plan for the paired difference. This diagnostic had zero discordant allocations. It cannot estimate the variance on discordant rows or support a confirmatory sample size. No collection under v2.
conditional_inference: For a future owner-authorized feasible design freeze minimum discordant rows and independent issuer and session support before collection. Use the v1 cluster bootstrap and single 99% envelope. A positive candidate policy mean and strictly positive lower confidence bound on the paired difference are both required for a superiority claim.

development_evidence.method: Apply v1 support and timing rules to the deduplicated 128-event development set with then-mature history. Accepted daily opening returns are offline proxies. Fit the comparator threshold using only selection decisions and opening magnitudes. Diagnostic coverage is in-sample for this threshold. No diagnostic close outcome is scored.
